name: Short-lived or rotating entities with common controllers
description: Entities are repeatedly formed, abandoned or replaced by successors sharing directors, addresses or history of prior defaulted companies.
fp: Legitimate restructurings and failed businesses occur; look for repeat patterns and unpaid liabilities.

links.name: Shell exporters opened for short period with identical directors
links.ctx: Several short-lived timber exporters share directors, addresses and bank signatories.

links.name: Short-lived waste companies with common directors
links.ctx: Companies appear, accumulate waste and vanish leaving liabilities.

links.name: Ownership and management by shell entities with rapid changes
links.ctx: Vessel owner or manager changes frequently, with newly formed companies and shared addresses.

links.name: Short-lived labour supplier with rotating entities
links.ctx: Company wound up or abandoned within one to two years, with successor firm at same address, same workers and clients.

links.name: Directors or addresses linked to prior defaulted VAT companies
links.ctx: Officers or premises previously appeared in VAT-defaulting entities or liquidations.
